SUMMARY & PURPOSE

Illustrative social-proof hero with editable customer count and rating fields marked as examples until approved evidence is supplied.

WHEN IT WORKS (IDEAL FOR)
•
Drafting a customer-proof layout before approved evidence is available
WHEN IT IS INAPPROPRIATE (AVOID FOR)
•
Publishing customer counts or ratings without supporting evidence
JOBS TO BE DONE
Provide a clear place for sourced adoption counts and rating evidence

Replace examples with sourced counts, approved identities, and the rating basis
